notes:
## Changelog
### Fixed
- Fixed host stops syncing after a failed client connect.
- Fixed strip moves use the wrong index.
- Fixed deleting a column from a split loses its width.
- Fixed a non-object JSON packet raises on every datagram with the DCS bridge.
- Fixed combo doesn’t revert when a profile fails to load.
- Fixed first connect attempt has no timeout.
- Fixed every label gets a duplicate hidden border and background.
- Fixed console commands may run on the stdin thread.
- Fixed Client error text is overwritten immediately.
- Fixed failed update can leave a corrupt exe.
- Fixed server processes messages from clients that haven’t sent hello.
- Fixed reconnectFailed is never emitted.
- Fixed with no default layout, “New Strip” silently does nothing.
- Fixed duplicate column name fails silently.
- Fixed DCS weather updates wipe the frequency table mid-edit
### Added
- Added better custom-layout check.
- Zero-padded numbers for all degree based values.
- Added JSON write on crash to help save partial work.
- Added cap to strip history (currently 200).
- Added check to remove empty “Transfer Strip” submenu.
- Added ability to close client server window without having to stop the server.
- Added default "Unassigned" column for all use cases. No more blank boards.
### Changed
- Changed FPSMBridge.lua to better support a server not allowing export without the ability to have an export script running on the server.
- Code cleanup for dead code.
- Changed Fuel to be represented as a float now instead of an integer.
  - Matches better with radio flow.
- Changed Ghost strip on strip movement to be a bar.
  - This will be better for visibility and easier understanding of placement.
